notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving the opponent control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 4.
